correctStatements.text: At 07:00 gus reported the Monday sales report arriving an hour late for European customers.
At 07:08 mina found the scheduler stores local times without a zone and the clocks had changed.
The scheduler computed the next run using the old offset.
At 07:30 vik checked that only the report schedules use the local time field.
At 07:42 mina wrote a patch that converts stored schedules to UTC and keeps the zone for display.
At 08:05 vik reviewed the patch and started deploying it.
At 08:20 gus saw the migration finish and a test run fire at the right time.
Customers got reports late one time and nothing was lost or sent twice.
Vik will add a test that runs the scheduler across both daylight saving changes.
Gus will tell the account managers what happened.
